data.name: Misti
data.gender_notes: Misti is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Myrto, which means myrtle. Myrtle was a symbol of love, beauty, and victory in ancient Greece. In the Bible, myrtle is used to represent purity and devotion. The name Misti carries the meaning “Myrtle sweetness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Misti usually hope their child will grow to embody myrtle sweetness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the sweetness and purity of divine love.
data.etymology: Misti belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Myrtle sweetness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Misti total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: In the Christian world, the name Misti is not commonly found in the English-speaking world. However, it carries a rich cultural heritage, particularly in Portuguese-speaking countries where the name has been in use for centuries. The name Misti evokes the beauty and elegance of the myrtle flower, symbolizing love, beauty, and purity. In some regions, the name Misti is also associated with the religious celebration of Corpus Christi, where myrtle is used to adorn the altars.
data.spiritual_significance: Misti is a beautiful and evocative Christian name, deeply connected to the ancient meaning of myrtle. Myrtle was considered a symbol of purity and dedication to the gods in ancient Greece, and this meaning continues in the Christian interpretation of the name. As a Christian name, Misti represents not only the purity and beauty of the myrtle flower but also the spiritual devotion and love of Christ. It is a name that carries with it the hope of a beautiful and meaningful life, rooted in the spiritual values of love, purity, and devotion.
